lines.say: dampened inflammation, maybe via NF-kB (cell and rodent studies; never tested in people)
inflammatory signaling fell in human gut-lining cells (lab studies)
eased inflammation and helped wounds heal (rodent studies)
crossed intact human skin poorly unless its barrier was broken (lab studies)
possible immune reactions if the peptide clumps; FDA had too little data to rule it out
